negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that fixed semiconductor basket breadth still relabels high-beta technology momentum, or the available free-OHLCV relation edge is already captured by accepted relation/source-priority sleeves.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially new PIT free-data evidence, such as real SMH/SOXX or industry ETF history, constituent additions, earnings/capex/catalyst provenance, borrow/options/ownership context, or closed forward replacement rows from a shared default-off adapter. The warehouse lacks SMH/SOXX, so this is a fixed-basket replay scout rather than a shared-paper-first adapter.
